kit.description: Obsolete since kit 0.10.0 and ignored: the installed version is read from apm.lock.yaml.

language.description: Language of the agent's replies and of every file produced (ISO 639-1), for example en or fr. The kit itself is in English.

code_host_org.description: Organization name on the code host, used to configure its MCP server.

front.description: Stack package folder under stacks/ (for example angular) or none.

back.description: Stack package folder under stacks/ (for example java-spring) or none.

e2e.description: End-to-end test tool: one test per acceptance criterion, playing the demo walkthrough; also used for screen checks. No unit or integration tests are written. none: the walkthrough is played by hand.

needs.description: Key client needs, one line each.

code.description: Folder of the POC source code.

budget_credits.description: GitHub AI credits budget for the POC (1 credit = 0.01 USD).

credits_per_aiu.description: AI credits per AIU found in Copilot logs. 1 verified against public prices on 2026-10-07.

distribution.description: demo-only: shown from the team's machines. delivered: source, binaries or a hosted service handed to the client.

licenses.description: SPDX ids or prefixes ending with * (for example GPL-*) added to the default policy.

component.description: Package URL without version (pkg:npm/foo) or with version (pkg:npm/foo@1.2.3).

client_requirements.description: Contractual compliance requirements of the client, one line.

run.description: How to start the POC with its tools, used by the Launch button of Vibe Studio. Filled by poc-4-plan-scenario, kept up to date by poc-5-build-scenario.

services.description: Started in this order. Each one waits for the port of the previous one.

cwd.description: Folder relative to the project root.

command.description: Command run in the system shell after the user confirms it.

port.description: Port that answers when the service is ready.

url.description: Local address to open, if the service has a screen.

open.description: Address opened once every service is ready.
